purpose: Design batch: does the shipped own-points member own_all (dl32own on ADS-B-matched rows, m25dl32own on the others; v66/v68 network table at weight 1.00) gain from ten OPDI flight-event columns (lever 7's surface times as network inputs)? The own-aircraft points went stacker (v63) -> network (v65, -0.98 s official); OPDI went into the stacker at LSZH (v68, -0.148 s official).
prior: docs/opdi_stack/README.md: OPDI in stack_resid_v3 read eq -0.083% in v66's chain (every interval below zero) but its transfer guard failed at EDDF / LEBL / EDDM / LEMD, exactly the airports whose OPDI coverage differs most between 2025 and 2026; LSZH alone (v68) passed. A network sees OPDI on every row, so a coverage-shift mask is declared here, before any fit or table.
exploration_disclosed: Known before this declaration: lever 7's screen / declared readings and v68's LSZH-only reading (all in v66's chain, development months only). No network fit with OPDI columns exists; no October reading of OPDI columns was made.
hardware: AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each), on-demand or spot, us-east-2 / us-east-1 / us-west-2 via SkyPilot from WSL, clusters prc-ctx5a-l (infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20261007.json). tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design --device cuda --threads 3, two lanes per GPU, unchanged code (no commit to the network runner or src/ since 5 October).

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design, unchanged: the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09, LIRF excluded), October monitored, October predictions only
protocol.inputs: candidates: --extra-features data/external/opdi/features_v19ownopdi (the shipped own-points tables, hash-checked against docs/dig/ctx_ownpoints_features_manifest.json, with ten OPDI columns appended by tools/ctx_opdi_features.py; manifest data/external/opdi/features_v19ownopdi/manifest.json). OPDI columns are never masked by the training masking (the masked list is the ADS-B list, as shipped).
protocol.coverage_shift_mask: fixed before the tables exist (label-free): per airport, the share of departures with opdi_has = 1 and with an opdi_stand_exit in January + July 2026 over the same shares in all of 2025; an airport whose ratio lies outside [0.5, 2.0] for either share, or whose 2025 matched share is below 2%, has all ten OPDI columns blanked (opdi_has 0, the rest NaN) in every month, development and ranking alike.
protocol.control: C = own_all as shipped: dl32own seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, m25dl32own seed mean on the others, from lever 5's GPU design fits (runs/ctx_own2/design/<variant>_s<seed>/design, seeds 9-16, L40S, configs/ctx_own2_design_v1.json, same code); reused, not refitted. The report checks each control run's variant_sha256 against this file's dl32own / m25dl32own (identical settings) and that it ran on cuda.

items.opdi_all: O = dl32opdi seed mean on matched rows, m25dl32opdi seed mean on the others (decision item)
items.opdi_matched: dl32opdi on matched rows, m25dl32own on the others (reported)
items.opdi_unmatched: dl32own on matched rows, m25dl32opdi on the others (reported)

readings.R1: October non-LIRF RMSE of each item (8-seed means); matched / unmatched; by airport; rows with an identified inbound and with own motion seen separately
readings.R2: recipe proxy (tools/nn_design_report.RecipeProxy, all October rows) of table = 0.25 committee + 0.75 [(1 - b) P + b X], P = tunnel 21's pool (0.5 ctx seeds 101-116 + 0.5 ctx_e24 seeds 117-132), b in {0.4, 0.5, 1.0}; share 0.85 reported beside it. b = 1.0 is v66's member weight.

protocol.decision: opdi_all is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 1.0 is at least 0.05 points below the control's, (b) its 8-seed standalone October non-LIRF RMSE is below the control's, and (c) the paired-day 95% interval of the proxy difference against the control at b = 1.0 lies below zero (tunnel 21's / lever 5's bar). Reported beside it: by airport, by OPDI coverage, the two half items. A development round is declared separately only after a GO.
protocol.never_read: No run of this declaration predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or of the ranking months. No official score or leaderboard enters.

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

budget: design 16 fits, about 10-14 min each at two lanes per L40S
